newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Kansas City, Mo..

text.p: SUMMARY NOTICE OF BOND SALE
City of Kansas City
Missouri
General Improvement Airport Refunding Revenue Bonds
Series 1997A
Sealed proposals will be received by the City Treasurer on behalf of the undersigned, Director of Finance of the City of Kansas City, Missouri (the
), on beh
governing body at City Hall, 414 East 12th Street, 1st Floor, Kansas City, Missouri 64106, until 9:00 a.m., Central Time, on
MARCH 20, 1997
(the Sale Date'') for the purchase of $29,415,000*
principal amount of General Improvement Airport Refunding Revenue Bonds, Series 1997A (the Bonds'').

The City reserves the right to postpone, from time to time, the date or time established for receipt of proposals. In the event of a postponement, the new date and/or time of sale will be announced via MUNIFACTS News Service at least 24 hours prior to the time proposals are to be submitted. The Bonds will be dated March 15, 1997, will be issued in book-entry only form and will bear interest from the date thereof at the rate or rates per annum specified in the official form of proposal of the successful bidder. Interest will be payable semiannually on March 1 and September 1 in each year, commencing September 1, 1997. The Bonds are subject to optional redemption as described in the
Preliminary Official Statement and the Notice of Bond Sale.

All proposals must be made on forms which may be procured from the City's Financial Advisors or the City Treasurer. No additions or alterations in such forms shall be made and any erasures may cause rejection of any bid. The City reserves the right to waive irregularities and to reject any or all proposals. Proposals accompanied by good faith checks shall be submitted in sealed envelopes addressed to the Director of Finance c/o City Treasurer and marked Proposal for the Purchase of General Improvement Airport Refunding Revenue Bonds, Series 1997A.'' Proposals may be mailed or delivered in person and must be received by the undersigned at the address given above prior to 9:00 o'clock A.M., Central Time, on Thursday, march 20, 1997. No proposal will be accepted by telecopy or telephone.
The City reserves the right to issue a Supplemental Notice of Sale not later than 1:00 p.m. (Central Time) on

Wednesday, March 19, 1997 via the MUNIFACTS News Service. If issued, the Supplemental Notice may modify (i) the maturity amounts of the Bonds, and/or (ii) such other terms of this Notice as the City determines. Any such modifications will supersede the maturities and such other terms as set forth herein. After proposals are received on the Sale Date, the City may revise the maturities of the Bonds, provided that the principal amount of the Bonds of any maturity shall not
be increased or decreased by an amount in excess of 10% the aggregate issue size will be increased or decreased by not more than 5%.

Unless all proposals for the Bonds are rejected, the award of the Bonds will be made on the basis of the lowest interest cost to the City specified in the proposals, which will be determined in accordance with the true interest cost method of calculation (TIC). If two or more proper proposals providing for identical amounts for the lowest TIC are received, the City shall determine which proposals, if any, shall be accepted, and its determination shall be final. It is the policy of the City that minority business enterprises and women's business enterprises shall have the maximum opportunity to participate in the performance of City contracts. The City strongly urges bidders to include such firms as part of their management groups or in their syndicates.

It is expected that the Bonds, together with approving opinions of Gilmore & Bell, P.C. and the Hardwick Law Firm, LLC, with Co-Bond Counsel to the City, will be delivered by the City to the successful bidder at the offices of DTC and the payment of the Bonds will take place at the offices of the City in Kansas City, Missouri, or in such other location as shall be determined by the City, on or about April 3, 1997, but in no event later than 30 days after the Sale Date.

Reference is made to the complete Notice of Bond Sale and the Preliminary Official Statement for a description of all terms and conditions of the sale. Additional information regarding the Bonds may be obtained from the City's

Financial Advisors, Fahnestock & Co., Inc., 4717 Grand Avenue, Kansas City, Missouri 64112, Attention: John M. Holland (816) 932-7039 or Knight Capital, L.L.C., 2405 Grand Avenue, Suite 500, Kansas City, Missouri 64108, Attention: Courtney Knight (816) 374-7611, or the City Treasurer, City Hall, 414 East 12th Street, Kansas City, Missouri 64106 (816) 274-1317. Dated this 7th day of March, 1997.
CITY OF KANSAS CITY, MISSOURI
Janice M. Reed
Director of Finance
*Subject to change as provided in the Post-Bid Revisions
in the Notice of Bond Sale.
(From The Bond Buyer)
